Four services call ts-train-service directly. Each one builds an HTTP URL to `ts-train-service:14567` in its main source code. I read these from a text search of the code and did not run the NextTrace graph tools.

- **ts-admin-basic-info-service** has two calls, at line 28 (the trains collection URL) and line 188 (a trains URL with an id appended).
- **ts-travel2-service** calls it at line 344, with a trainTypeId appended.
- **ts-travel-service** calls it at line 410, with a trainTypeId appended.
- **ts-basic-service** calls it at line 142, with a trainTypeId appended.

Test files for ts-admin-basic-info-service and ts-basic-service also mention the URL, but I left them out because they aren't real callers.

`ts-ui-dashboard/nginx.conf:74` also proxies to `http://ts-train-service:14567`. That is the front-end gateway rather than a service-to-service call, so I didn't list it.
